Plan (exact R1/R2 set; no files or Git changed):

- R1: In `src/recorder/scanner.ts`, repair the sole `authorization-header` rule at its owning scanner seam by removing the quote-closing alternatives that can terminate before CR/LF; make every `Authorization:`/`Authorization=` form consume the entire CR/LF-bounded value. Do not add a scanner or admission path and do not alter the independent Basic/Bearer or `token-assignment` rules. Extend `test/recorder-extract-scan.test.ts` with focused whole-quoted Digest/custom values containing escaped auth-parameter quotes, asserting no parameter/suffix survives while CR/LF-following lines remain intact and existing Basic/Bearer/Token cases remain green. Add the same escaped whole-quoted form to the existing external-input promotion regression and assert promoted input/artifacts contain neither complete credentials nor suffixes. Regenerate `dist/recorder/scanner.js` with the repository build.
- R2: Make no production change. Re-run the existing isolated-pack stress test and Collector/Recorder/Reviewer package-lifecycle tests, including the default-concurrency full suite, to verify the current private prepack materialization and package lifecycle behavior.
- Apply verification/closure: run focused R1 tests; focused isolated-pack and package-lifecycle tests; `npm run typecheck`; full default-concurrency `npm test`; `npm pack --dry-run --json`; and `git diff --check`. Confirm only authorized source/test/generated-dist changes, preserve all historical artifacts, do not inspect sessions, create exactly one new forward commit (no amend/rewrite), then require a clean tree and verify HEAD is a strict descendant of the starting HEAD.
- The Apply response will be exactly one Markdown table with columns `R#` and `Disposition`, rows `R1` and `R2` exactly once, no other R-like keys, and each disposition exactly `implemented(<test>)` or `refused(<reason>)`.
